subject.title: feat(browser): add secure per-tab copilot panel

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this Gateway-integrated, origin-bound copilot architecture as the canonical successor to the still-open side-panel proposal at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93680?
rationale: Both PRs target the same user-facing per-tab copilot but differ substantially in Gateway, pairing, delivery, and ownership boundaries; code review cannot choose the permanent product contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt this architecture
options.body: Confirm this PR as the canonical direction, require final-head security/lifecycle proof, and route the older proposal to build on these contracts.

options.title: Adopt the earlier panel direction
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93680 as the canonical user-facing path and extract only independently needed hardening from this branch.

options.title: Define a narrowed shared contract first
options.body: Pause both implementations until maintainers specify the supported pairing, event-delivery, and tab-binding contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt this architecture
recommendation.body: Confirm this PR as the canonical direction, require final-head security/lifecycle proof, and route the older proposal to build on these contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch author is the strongest available routing point for the proposed Gateway and browser-copilot contract, with 2CB2 as the adjacent implementation owner.
